## Contribute Your Paper

[📝 Add a paper](https://github.com/Biohub/awesome-esm/issues/new?template=add-paper.md){.btn .btn-primary}

---

## How Papers Are Organized

Each paper includes:
- **Title & authors**
- **Publication details** (journal, prestige, lab validation status)
- **Summary** (2-3 sentences)
- **ESM model(s) used** (specific techniques)
- **Impact** (why it matters)
- **Tags** (research areas)
- **Links** (paper, code, data if available)
